items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: When he came to The Columns and worked with Dave and Kenny Hawkins on drums and I was playing bass

ctx.x: Well I found out something afterwards that really changed my opinion of him. When he came to The Columns and worked with Dave and Kenny Hawkins on drums and I was playing bass, he was very relaxed and very at ease and had a great time and swung like mad and was taking everybody to dinner, was the toast of the Cape and you know he was really having a ball. Because with Dave and the trio he didn’t have to think about a thing. He’d call a tune and Dave was in there even if we weren’t. And Dave was solid as the Rock…
Yeah. Quite a practical joker, wasn’t he?
